summary.text: Melanie Morgan is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives, representing District 29-Position 1 since January 14, 2019, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Morgan served as vice chair of the Rural Development, Agriculture, and Natural Resources Committee and was assigned to the Capital Budget, Commerce & Gaming, and House Rules committees during the 2023-2024 session, according to Ballotpedia.
